comparison.rationale: Source-grounded review identifies a meaning-changing CUDA predicate error at zero-based relation 49, aligned to CPU relation 41. Additional topology and coverage differences are retained for review; no migration-causality claim is made.

scientific_review.index_convention: Zero-based indices into comparison.validated_relations; all raw relations and automatic alignment remain unchanged.
scientific_review.review_scope: Reviewed all 50 CPU and 62 CUDA assertions/qualifiers against their exact frozen-source evidence, all 47 automatic alignments, all unmatched outputs, node identities/types, and resulting graph predicates.

decisive_finding.frozen_source_evidence: These findings suggest that SFPQ overexpression could increase antioxidant enzyme levels, enhance antioxidant function, and mitigate the oxidative damage induced by Aβ.
decisive_finding.assessment: Both assertions/effects describe potential mitigation of Abeta-induced oxidative damage after SFPQ overexpression. The CUDA predicate instead encodes induction of oxidative damage for SFPQ-to-Abeta, conflating the Abeta-induced damage with the SFPQ mitigation relationship. This is not synonymous wording or a negated-field flip. The accepted graph builder preserves the erroneous predicate unchanged, so scientific edge interpretation differs despite valid substring grounding.

alignment_summary.rule: Supplemental pairs document semantic relationships without deleting, merging or rewriting any outputs. Residual outputs include repeated support and extra coverage, not necessarily distinct scientific discoveries.

supplemental_alignments.assessment: Same SFPQ-to-Tau potential oligomerization/misfolding claim and source sentence; harmless predicate phrasing and terminal punctuation differences. The conservative automatic matcher left this pair unaligned because several Tau relations share endpoints.

Identical assertion/evidence that HO-1 is an NRF2 target gene. CPU encodes NRF2-to-HO-1/transcriptional_target; CUDA HO-1-to-NRF2/target_gene_of. This is inverse target-gene formulation, not evidence of opposite transcriptional regulation. Literal directed graph topology differs and is retained; neither direction is normalized for comparison.

cpu_only_relations.assessment: Descriptive association of SFPQ with Tau oligomers in rpAD patient brains. CUDA retains the nearby potential oligomerization/misfolding claim but not this separate observational relation/context. This is residual coverage variation; it is not silently equated with the mechanistic hypothesis.

cuda_additional_relations.assessment: Additional abstract evidence for the shared SFPQ-overexpression APP reduction claim; retained alongside CUDA 37, not collapsed.
Additional abstract evidence for the shared SFPQ-overexpression Tau reduction claim; retained alongside CUDA 38, not collapsed.
RNA-binding-protein classification from the DBHS-family source statement; source-supported background granularity.
Broad neurodegenerative-disorders background relation in addition to the shared specific disease relations. The accepted assembly keeps this source form on its own node.
Additional source-supported SFPQ-overexpression/AD hippocampal-arrangement finding. CPU preserves the cognition finding but not this morphological outcome; potentially relevant coverage difference.
Additional source sentence supporting increased PSD95 after SFPQ overexpression; repeated shared biology with additional AD-mouse context.

Source-supported Tau decrease following SFPQ overexpression. This occurrence selects Gene-typed SFPQ rather than the Chemical-typed SFPQ mention used for CPU's decrease relation; the accepted unchanged NER/assembly retains both identities.

Source-explicit PI3K/AKT pathway activation split into a PI3K edge. Uses Gene-typed SFPQ, creating a new canonical endpoint pair; both arms also retain the separate Chemical-typed SFPQ PI3K phosphorylation/ratio finding.

Source-explicit PI3K/AKT pathway activation split into an AKT edge. Uses Gene-typed SFPQ, creating a new canonical endpoint pair; both arms also retain the separate Chemical-typed SFPQ AKT phosphorylation/ratio finding.

endpoint_topology_comparison.assessment: Full node IDs, labels, types, pair multiplicities and directed edges are retained in comparison. One reverse target-gene encoding and eight other CUDA-only directed pairs explain the pair-set differences. No entity merging or topology normalization was introduced.

negation_comparison.assessment: The decisive predicate error is a biological meaning change despite negated=false in both arms.

qualifier_comparison.shared_findings: Both arms preserve SFPQ overexpression, AD-mouse cognition/memory benefit, APP/Tau decrease, CREB/PSD95 changes, GST/HO-1 increases, Bcl-2/Bax increases, and explicit p-PI3K/PI3K and p-AKT/AKT ratios with Vector-group comparison. Knockdown/knockout and speculative Tau claims retain their stated intervention/modality. Most other qualifier differences are capitalization, phrasing or additional supporting detail.
qualifier_comparison.material_issue: CUDA relation 49's mitigation assertion/intervention/effects are compatible with CPU relation 41, but contradict its own induces_oxidative_damage predicate. Qualifiers do not repair a contradictory graph predicate.
qualifier_comparison.shared_limitations: Neither cognitive relation preserves the full four-week/control/NOR/Y-maze experimental detail; neither arm's Bcl-2/Bax relations explicitly retain the ratio increase. These shared omissions are accepted-output limitations, not evidence of a CUDA-specific change.

grounding_comparison.assessment: All evidence resolves exactly in the frozen source, and all validated surface forms meet production grounding checks. Substring validity does not certify entailment: CUDA relation 49's predicate is unsupported by the mitigation sentence. Other added relations have source support; direction/coverage/qualifier cautions are listed explicitly.

scientific_review.causal_interpretation: One uncontrolled-in-randomness A/B cannot distinguish ordinary provider variance from sensitivity to the microscopic input-score difference. MATERIAL_DIVERGENCE describes an observed scientific graph-output discrepancy, not proof that CUDA NER caused it or that the CUDA runtime is scientifically invalid.
scientific_review.next_action: STOP for Talia review. No CBL, repeat controls, role calls, composed CUDA smoke, score/prompt/output fixes, profile promotion or Phase 3.
